latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Script Yijia skill.

- Instantly generate ready-to-use video scripts from your brief, with AI-powered structure and export.
- Supports text and file uploads (MP4, MOV, TXT, DOCX, up to 200MB) for script generation and editing.
- Full 1080p MP4 export, with download links delivered in under a minute.
- Automated session management and credits handling (with temporary free token support).
- Clear, structured API-driven workflow for content creators and marketers needing fast turnaround.
- Includes robust error handling and timeline summarization for a smooth editing experience.
